label: Scale changes the forces controlling skeletal form
reason: The theorem counts pentagons in an assumed trivalent spherical lattice; it does not compare molecular and mechanical forces across skeletal scales.

label: Vesicle grooves template a hexagonal radiolarian lattice
reason: Euler and handshaking equations do not prove the proposed secretion and vesicle-groove mechanism or that vesicles produce the observed network.

label: Lattice-shell form is independent of skeletal material
reason: The theorem proves only that every trivalent pentagon-hexagon spherical lattice has twelve pentagons, regardless of an unused material parameter; it does not prove that different biominerals form equally regular lattices or share the required topology.
